prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop landing-page composition option 2, 16:9 landscape
Primary request: Render a complete first viewport and the start of the next section for the real Clinimed Odontologia institutional website, edge to edge, crisp readable Portuguese, no browser frame. The visitor must immediately recognize a multidisciplinary dental clinic in Votuporanga and a working WhatsApp evaluation action.
Input images: Image 1 is the official Clinimed logo and must remain recognizable. Image 2 contributes only authentic clinic lighting and spatial cues; remove or hide every old PLUG name and blue/yellow brand element.
Committed world: Pavilhão Clinimed. Luminous off-white ground, deep Clinimed green, one lime light band, translucent green glass, pale wood, bright daylight, large rounded humane sans. The page is a continuous care pavilion, not a standard split hero.
Composition option 2: make the pavilion itself the navigation path. One monumental translucent green-glass horseshoe begins behind the top glass-bubble menu, descends through the viewport, frames a wide real-clinic panorama, and closes around the WhatsApp appointment control. Place the main copy inside the calm center of this architecture rather than in a separate column. The next section begins through the open lower edge of the horseshoe.
Text: menu “Início · Quem Somos · Tratamentos · Profissionais · Depoimentos · Blog · Contatos” plus “Agende sua avaliação”. Headline “Seu sorriso, cuidado por inteiro.” Supporting line “Mais de 40 procedimentos em um só lugar.” Action “Agendar pelo WhatsApp”. Proof “Desde 2010 · Votuporanga/SP · Atendimento humanizado”. Next heading “Cuidado completo, no seu tempo”.
Constraints: one dominant horseshoe move, functional navigation and controls, no equal card row, no generic tooth stock image, no invented awards, no prices, no extra logos, no watermark.
